SANTANDER UK PLC
€35 BILLION GLOBAL COVERED BOND PROGRAMME
Admission to trading of Transferable Securities - Series 98
The following covered bonds issued by Santander UK plc (the Issuer) have today (9 September 2026) been admitted to trading on the main market of the London Stock Exchange plc:
·           Series 98 U.S.$1,500,000,000 Fixed Rate Covered Bonds due September 2029 (XS3492392488).

The Series 98 Covered Bonds are issued under the Issuer's €35 billion Global Covered Bond Programme (the Programme) pursuant to a prospectus dated 17 March 2026 as supplemented on 1 May 2026, 8 May 2026, 5 June 2026, 22 July 2026 and 7 August 2026 (the Prospectus), read together with the Final Terms dated 8 September 2026 relating to the Series 98 Covered Bonds (the Final Terms). Full information on the Issuer and the offer of the Series 98 Covered Bonds is only available on the basis of the Prospectus, read together with the Final Terms.
The Prospectus and the Final Terms will be available on the website of the Issuer at https://www.santander.co.uk/about-santander/investor-relations/santander-uk-covered-bonds.
